items.title: Luis Conte interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 24, 2025
items.q: Chocolaté one days says, “Hey we have a wedding on Saturday and I’m going to have a little bigger band, do you want to play bongos with us?”

ctx.x: Yeah sure go ahead, take our gig.

Yeah sure man. Now that I thought about it this guy probably thought I was a fool man totally, I [inaudible]. Anyway so from that gig he said, I said, “Hey can I bring some bongos and sit in with you guys? You’ve got a conga player and a timbale player.” “Yeah okay bring them.” So I go down there and play bongos with them, you know for free, and Chocolaté one days says, “Hey we have a wedding on Saturday and I’m going to have a little bigger band, do you want to play bongos with us?” Man, I thought I was – I went…
They sure did. I’m going to fast forward a little bit but on your website and on you know Googling you, I went through the trouble of counting all the credits they had for you.
